verdict.rationale: Tavily is a hosted web-search and extraction API, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes calling the public Tavily API (SDK keyless mode 'against the public Tavily API', API keys, credits and rate limits), with no documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment. The SDKs and MCP server are clients of the hosted API, not a self-hostable core.
